description.message: Simulate all whitelisted browser windows as active by spoofing the visibility state event and more!

action_title_enabled.message: Enabled. The current tab (top website: $HOST$) stays active while in the background. Click to disable it for $HOST$.

action_title_disabled.message: Not enabled. Click to keep the current tab (top website: $HOST$) active while in the background for $HOST$.

action_title_unknown.message: This tab cannot be handled by this extension. Open a regular http(s) website, such as youtube.com, and click again.

title_star_note.message: The "*" wildcard in your host list enables this extension on all websites. To change this, visit the options page.
